subject: Windows shipped D2 bridge binary reproducibility

builds.label: local older build
builds.note: different size and build date; not part of the same-source/same-lock comparison

offsets: 0x108-0x109: PE TimeDateStamp (4-byte field; low two bytes differ)
sameBlobComparison.normalization: Zero the 4-byte PE timestamp, the three 4-byte debug-directory timestamps, and the 16-byte PDB GUID.

cause: The executable code and data are identical. The differing bytes are build metadata: the PE timestamp, debug-directory timestamps and the PDB GUID. No code, relocation, string or dependency content differs in the same-source/same-lock pair.

guarantees.dependencyResolution: reproducible when the committed lock is used (ec901557)
guarantees.buildInputsAndProcedure: reproducible for the shipped graph on the CI runner
guarantees.byteForByteBinary: not achieved across environments because of embedded timestamps/PDB GUID
guarantees.distributionIdentity: the per-candidate manifest hash binds the exact immutable artifact; cross-build hash equality is not claimed

contractEffect: The binding plan requires a locked dependency graph and exact artifact identity per candidate, not cross-environment byte equality. The remediation qualifies the exact CI-built candidate and records its hash; it does not assert that independent builds produce the same SHA-256.
localOlderBuild: The 94811767 local build predates the current run and has a different size; it is retained as historical evidence and is not used as a reproducibility comparator.
